after.description: [GO, UP, MX] Live Preview of Content in CMS — Enable real-time content preview from Contentstack's Live Preview feature, so that content editors see their edits reflected on the page without a full reload, across GO Transit, UP Express, and MX brands.
after.title: [GO, UP, MX] Live Preview of Content in CMS

notes: Novel story — Contentstack Live Preview does not exist in the codebase. The attachment point is useContent (236 callers), the central hook through which all Contentstack content flows. ACs were empty; populated from description with measurable criteria. Contentstack is unreachable at test time so VCs stop at our boundary with explicit mock assumptions.
